remarks: Welcome to this beautifully finished two-storey in Brickyard, Stony Plain, where thoughtful design meets everyday functionality. Offering 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, an upper bonus room and a walkout basement backing a pond, this home is filled with elevated details throughout. The main floor features an inviting great room with a custom fireplace and built-in desk, while the kitchen stands out with a furniture-style island, champagne bronze pull-down faucet and walk-through pantry. Designer finishes include stained maple corbels, statement mirrors, brushed bronze and champagne bronze fixtures, gold ensuite accents and custom tilework. Upstairs, the primary retreat offers a luxurious 5-piece ensuite with a recessed shower niche and coordinating tile. Complete with a double attached garage and only steps from the new rec centre and Westview School, this home delivers a refined blend of comfort, design and modern living. (id:67522)
